title: Page 18
transc:
A. H. Caldwell  Washn Mar 8th 1864. 330 PM 
Imogene For Palermo, In = galls Tulip Spark Rucker in forms 
me that he has sent all his optic water Weasel
to Hug and that Pearl Biggs at Bunyan has been
ordered to send all that may be at that Trinity
yacht I Stephen Milans order with Spark Rucker who told
me he would forward it to day Yardstick In addition
to the Wayworn sent from here and ordered from Bunyan 
a large Waltzer has been ordered from Girdle Tulip not
considering the Waltzer from Granada there will be sufficient Weasel
at Hulk for Allen Seward Summer and Silvers and I
should think it would be optic by Wedlock evening Yacht
The Kirby Pekin Silvers are being purchased the first
lot will arrive here Wedlock I have notified Cap Feilner
yacht I could get no definite Spencer as to how
long it would take to furnish the whole number asked
for Yawl Wm T. How = Ell Capt & A Vermont



A H Caldwell  Washn Mch 9" 1864 12. noon
Viola For Palermo Ingalls Yardstick
Crowd will be down to
the Persia Talbot Annal to
more row Wiley Lantern shark
